name: Gottlieb Klebaum

events.place: Zalazzia, Kovelsky Uyezd, Volhynian Governorate, Russian Empire

notes:
According to "Reminiscences of Part Three of the Family Tree" received from Edward Zelmer in Akron, page 58: Quote "Gustav Klebaum told us how his father Gottlieb died.  Gustav and Daniel were out in the forest cutting down a tree.  As the tree began to fall they noticed their father walking through the trees towards them.  They shouted, "Papa gay forte der Baum fallt hier!" (Papa go away the tree is fallin here!)  He stepped back two steps but it was too late.  He was struck in the head by a small branch and was killed instantly."

-Allan Zelmer
